Paige makes a weak damage commitment expensive by shielding its target and rooting the follow-up. Bait the barrier, switch targets, and commit after her defensive window ends. A cleanse lets you respond to the root; it does not remove the barrier on an enemy.

Paige’s barrier and root are different problems from choosing bullet or spirit resistance. Dispel Magic restores your response to an eligible root, while Cursed Relic has a role against eligible enemy protection. Check the follow-up damage before buying resistance, and do not assume anti-heal shrinks Plot Armor’s ordinary barrier.
